summary: The customer inquired about a change in credit card reward program.

intents.keywords: हेलो मैं शुभम गुप्ता मेरे क्रेडिट कार्ड का रिवॉर्ड ... प्रोग्राम बदल गया है।

issues.issue: Customer's credit card reward program changed.

intents.actions of agent: Agent checked the details and informed the customer about the policy change. Agent offered to register a request for the old program.
intents.Process Request: Request to revert to the old reward program.
intents.resolution: Agent will register a request to revert to the old reward program and provide an update.
